observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoors on a polished wooden floor against a rustic stone wall, with seated musicians playing in the background.
observation.dancers: One male and one female dancer, performing as a couple.
observation.formation_and_space: Couples facing each other or moving in circular patterns around the performance space.
observation.posture: Upright torso, upright head, relaxed knees, weight shifting between feet.
observation.footwork: Shuffling and stepping pattern on the beat, low to the ground; precise foot placement cannot be seen in detail.
observation.arms_and_hands: The female dancer holds the sides of her large skirt and moves it gracefully; the male dancer holds a hat in one hand and gestures or holds the female's hand.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively upright and stable while shifting weight; minimal hip isolation.
observation.partnering: Open dance position transitioning to close hold and turning together, with clear lead and follow.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Turns performed in place and while traveling; bending of knees; male dancer kneels briefly at the beginning.
observation.costume_and_props: Female wears an elaborate traditional white ruffled dress with red embroidery and hair ornaments; male wears a white shirt, dark trousers, and a hat.
observation.cannot_infer: Low-resolution and camera angles obscure exact foot positions and weight transfer details.

signature_moments.what: Male dancer kneels on one knee while the female dancer circles around him, holding and fanning her ruffled skirt.
Dancers move apart and circle each other while manipulating their costumes and hats, keeping an upright posture.
Couple comes together in a close embrace hold, spinning in unison while maintaining precise foot steps.
